<?php
/**
 * SearchIndexer - Document indexing service for full-text search
 * Supports configurable field mappings and analyzers via environment
 */

class IndexConfiguration {
    private array $fieldMappings = [];
    private array $analyzers = [];
    private array $settings = [
        'max_fields' => 50,
        'max_depth' => 5,
        'allow_dynamic' => false,
        'index_prefix' => 'search_'
    ];

    public function __construct() {
        $this->loadFromEnvironment();
    }

    private function loadFromEnvironment(): void {
        $configJson = getenv('SEARCH_INDEX_CONFIG');
        if ($configJson === false) {
            return;
        }
        $config = json_decode($configJson, true);
        if (!is_array($config)) {
            return;
        }
        if (isset($config['settings']) && is_array($config['settings'])) {
            foreach ($config['settings'] as $key => $value) {
                $this->settings[$key] = $value;
            }
        }
        if (isset($config['analyzers']) && is_array($config['analyzers'])) {
            $this->analyzers = $config['analyzers'];
        }
    }

    public function getSetting(string $key, $default = null) {
        return $this->settings[$key] ?? $default;
    }

    public function getAnalyzer(string $name): ?array {
        return $this->analyzers[$name] ?? null;
    }

    public function getFieldMappings(): array {
        return $this->fieldMappings;
    }
}

class DocumentProcessor {
    private IndexConfiguration $config;
    private array $processedFields = [];

    public function __construct(IndexConfiguration $config) {
        $this->config = $config;
    }

    public function processDocument(array $document, array $schema): array {
        $this->processedFields = [];
        $result = $this->flattenAndIndex($document, $schema, '', 0);
        return $result;
    }

    private function flattenAndIndex(array $data, array $schema, string $prefix, int $depth): array {
        $maxDepth = $this->config->getSetting('max_depth', 5);
        if ($depth > $maxDepth) {
            return [];
        }

        $indexed = [];
        $allowDynamic = $this->config->getSetting('allow_dynamic', false);

        foreach ($data as $key => $value) {
            $fieldPath = $prefix === '' ? $key : $prefix . '.' . $key;

            if (!$allowDynamic && !$this->fieldInSchema($fieldPath, $schema)) {
                continue;
            }

            if (is_array($value) && !$this->isSequential($value)) {
                $nested = $this->flattenAndIndex($value, $schema, $fieldPath, $depth + 1);
                $indexed = array_merge($indexed, $nested);
            } else {
                $indexed[$fieldPath] = $this->analyzeField($fieldPath, $value, $schema);
            }
        }

        return $indexed;
    }

    private function fieldInSchema(string $path, array $schema): bool {
        $parts = explode('.', $path);
        $current = $schema;
        foreach ($parts as $part) {
            if (!isset($current[$part])) {
                return false;
            }
            $current = $current[$part];
        }
        return true;
    }

    private function isSequential(array $arr): bool {
        return array_keys($arr) === range(0, count($arr) - 1);
    }

    private function analyzeField(string $path, $value, array $schema): array {
        $analyzerName = $this->getAnalyzerForField($path, $schema);
        $analyzer = $this->config->getAnalyzer($analyzerName);

        if ($analyzer === null) {
            return ['raw' => $value, 'tokens' => is_string($value) ? explode(' ', strtolower($value)) : [$value]];
        }

        return $this->applyAnalyzer($value, $analyzer);
    }

    private function getAnalyzerForField(string $path, array $schema): string {
        $parts = explode('.', $path);
        $current = $schema;
        foreach ($parts as $part) {
            if (isset($current[$part])) {
                $current = $current[$part];
            }
        }
        return is_array($current) && isset($current['analyzer']) ? $current['analyzer'] : 'default';
    }

    private function applyAnalyzer($value, array $analyzer): array {
        $result = ['raw' => $value];
        $text = is_string($value) ? $value : (string)$value;

        if (isset($analyzer['lowercase']) && $analyzer['lowercase']) {
            $text = strtolower($text);
        }
        if (isset($analyzer['trim']) && $analyzer['trim']) {
            $text = trim($text);
        }

        $tokenizer = $analyzer['tokenizer'] ?? 'whitespace';
        switch ($tokenizer) {
            case 'whitespace':
                $result['tokens'] = preg_split('/\s+/', $text, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
                break;
            case 'ngram':
                $n = $analyzer['ngram_size'] ?? 3;
                $result['tokens'] = $this->generateNgrams($text, $n);
                break;
            default:
                $result['tokens'] = [$text];
        }

        return $result;
    }

    private function generateNgrams(string $text, int $n): array {
        $ngrams = [];
        $len = mb_strlen($text);
        for ($i = 0; $i <= $len - $n; $i++) {
            $ngrams[] = mb_substr($text, $i, $n);
        }
        return $ngrams;
    }
}

class SearchIndexService {
    private DocumentProcessor $processor;
    private IndexConfiguration $config;
    private array $indices = [];

    public function __construct() {
        $this->config = new IndexConfiguration();
        $this->processor = new DocumentProcessor($this->config);
    }

    public function createIndex(string $name, array $schema): void {
        $prefix = $this->config->getSetting('index_prefix', 'search_');
        $this->indices[$prefix . $name] = ['schema' => $schema, 'documents' => []];
    }

    public function indexDocument(string $indexName, string $docId, array $document): bool {
        $prefix = $this->config->getSetting('index_prefix', 'search_');
        $fullName = $prefix . $indexName;

        if (!isset($this->indices[$fullName])) {
            return false;
        }

        $schema = $this->indices[$fullName]['schema'];
        $processed = $this->processor->processDocument($document, $schema);
        $this->indices[$fullName]['documents'][$docId] = $processed;
        return true;
    }

    public function search(string $indexName, string $query): array {
        $prefix = $this->config->getSetting('index_prefix', 'search_');
        $fullName = $prefix . $indexName;

        if (!isset($this->indices[$fullName])) {
            return [];
        }

        $queryTokens = explode(' ', strtolower($query));
        $results = [];

        foreach ($this->indices[$fullName]['documents'] as $docId => $fields) {
            $score = 0;
            foreach ($fields as $fieldPath => $fieldData) {
                if (!isset($fieldData['tokens'])) continue;
                foreach ($queryTokens as $qt) {
                    $score += count(array_filter($fieldData['tokens'], fn($t) => str_contains($t, $qt)));
                }
            }
            if ($score > 0) {
                $results[] = ['id' => $docId, 'score' => $score];
            }
        }

        usort($results, fn($a, $b) => $b['score'] - $a['score']);
        return $results;
    }

    public function getConfig(): IndexConfiguration {
        return $this->config;
    }
}

// Entry point for HTTP requests
if (php_sapi_name() !== 'cli') {
    $service = new SearchIndexService();
    $input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
    
    if (!is_array($input) || !isset($input['action'])) {
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid request']);
        exit;
    }

    $response = match($input['action']) {
        'create_index' => (function() use ($service, $input) {
            $service->createIndex($input['name'] ?? '', $input['schema'] ?? []);
            return ['status' => 'created'];
        })(),
        'index' => (function() use ($service, $input) {
            $ok = $service->indexDocument($input['index'] ?? '', $input['id'] ?? '', $input['document'] ?? []);
            return ['status' => $ok ? 'indexed' : 'error'];
        })(),
        'search' => (function() use ($service, $input) {
            return $service->search($input['index'] ?? '', $input['query'] ?? '');
        })(),
        default => ['error' => 'Unknown action']
    };

    header('Content-Type: application/json');
    echo json_encode($response);
}
